title: Ukutya Okungalindelekanga Komdala
intro: Kwiindawo ezingcwele zeNdlu ka-Allah, umkhonzi kaThixo owayesele ekhulile wafumana imfihlakalo enzulu eyayingalindelwanga. Lo mntu uzinikeleyo, owayesele ekhulile ngeminyaka yokuba ngumzali wemvelo, wabona into engaqhelekanga eyatyhila inceba engenamda yoThixo. Ingxaki ikukufumanisa eli xesha lilibalekileyo kubomi babaprofeti.
clues: Abantu bam baziwa ngokuba nguSirayeli, inzala yosolusapho omkhulu wamandulo.
Ndachitha ubusuku bam ndithandaza, ndiguqa phambi kweNkosi yam etempileni.
Ndanikwa unyana ebudaleni bam, isipho endingazange ndiyeke ukumdumisa ngaso uAllah.
Uvavanyo lwam lwaluquka ukufumana isondlo esasibonakala kumphefumlo oselula ophantsi kokhathalelo lwam.
Ndandingumprofeti ogama linguZakariya, ndinikwe umsebenzi wokunyamekela uMariyam eBayt al-Maqdis.
Impendulo ikwivesi apho uAllah wamamkela uMariya waza wamnika ukutya.

arabic: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍۢ وَأَنۢبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًۭا وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا ۖ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا ٱلْمِحْرَابَ وَجَدَ عِندَهَا رِزْقًۭا ۖ قَالَ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ أَنَّىٰ لَكِ هَـٰذَا ۖ قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verse: So her Lord accepted her with good acceptance and caused her to grow in a good manner and put her in the care of Zechariah. Every time Zechariah entered upon her in the prayer chamber, he found with her provision. He said, "O Mary, from where is this [coming] to you?" She said, "It is from Allāh. Indeed, Allāh provides for whom He wills without account." (3:37)
